content_sections.heading: SVNIRTAR General Duty Medical Officer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SVNIRTAR General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant): MBBS Degree. Desirable: MD in PMR or 2 years Diploma Course in PMR after MD Medicine or Diplomate in PMR from National Board of Examination or any other equivalent qualification or MS (Orthopaedics)

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 56 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant): Rs.80,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SVNIRTAR General Duty Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for SVNIRTAR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) at Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (SVNIRTAR).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for GDMO (Consultant) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) position in this SVNIRTAR recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for SVNIRTAR GDMO Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) post is scheduled for 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the GDMO (Consultant) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) position should not be more than 56 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for GDMO (Consultant) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree. A desirable qualification includes MD in PMR or an equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) post will receive a salary of Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SVNIRTAR GDMO Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SVNIRTAR GDMO Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) (Consultant) post will be based solely on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Cuttack, Odisha, at the Swami Vivekanand National Institute of Rehabilitation Training and Research (SVNIRTAR).

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all original documents, self-attested photocopies, recent passport-size photographs, and a duly filled application form if specified.
